summary: Checks mode uses the gh pr view rollup and queries gh pr checks only at the full 100-context page boundary. Merge mode selects the newest attempt per check identity from the already-read rollup without another population query. Selected failures end the merge wait except in UNSTABLE, while lifecycle outcomes retain precedence. The staged poll interval, carried deadline, bounded slice, and stalled-command retry remain unchanged.
title: The ci-wait PR population follows the rollup page boundary
